seo.title: Privacy Policy & Legal Notice | Guide Group Global
seo.description: Service provider details and the privacy policy of the Guide Group Global website, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Service provider
sections.text: This website is operated by Golden Activity Kft., a company registered in Hungary. The company's registration and contact details are listed at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: When you complete the consultation form, we receive your name, email, phone number, place of residence, purpose of consultation and any details you enter yourself. This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies without your consent.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
sections.text: Your data is used only to answer your consultation request and provide the services you ask for. The legal basis is your consent and steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(a) and (b)).

sections.title: Form delivery and processors
sections.text: Forms on this site are delivered to the company's email through the FormSubmit form service. Your data is never sold or passed on to third parties for advertising.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: Data is kept only as long as needed to follow up on your request, and at most until the relevant statutory deadlines expire, after which it is deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to access your data, request correction or erasure, restrict processing, object to it and withdraw your consent at any time. To do so, email the company. You may also lodge a complaint with the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH).
